unknown_clinical.message: I do not have verified instructions for that. Follow the dispatcher and AED prompts.

unclear_audio.message: Please repeat that if you can.

out_of_scope.message: This assistant only supports CPR training and emergency information.

model_unavailable.message: AI assistance is unavailable. The dispatcher call and AED can continue independently.

rules: No general-answer fallback or open-web search during an incident.
Do not invent medical facts or confirmed diagnoses.
Do not interrupt or talk over dispatcher/AED prompts.
Fallback wording is a design draft requiring clinical and human-factors approval.
